title: Headphones
author: nisu
licenseEvidence: The original OpenGameArt listing credits nisu and explicitly lists CC0. The source author links their collection at 3dmodelscc0.com. No login or purchase was required for the linked archive.
scale: Presentation scale: assembled height 0.24 units, approximately metres. This is an estimate; source OBJ has no declared unit.
modifications: OBJ converted to GLB; physical islands split into movable headband and earcups; estimated presentation height 0.24m; 4K maps reduced to 2K; DirectX normals converted to OpenGL; ORM channels packed; source logo/albedo/emission maps omitted, neutral charcoal factor assigned.

verification.geometryLoader: Three.js GLTFLoader.parseAsync passed in Node with texture decoding stubbed (no WebGL rendering)
verification.textureHeaders: 2 embedded PNG images, both 2048×2048; all buffer ranges valid; no external URI dependencies

credit: Headphones by nisu — https://opengameart.org/content/headphones — CC0 1.0. Converted, split into movable components, textures optimized and material recolored.
